name: MC - Work Todo Extended Graph Writeback
purpose: Apply capability-gated work To Do mutations through delegated Microsoft Graph calls.

trigger.type: When an HTTP request is received
trigger.security: Tenant authentication when available; otherwise protect and rotate the signed trigger URL.

actions.name: Validate_request_and_capabilities
requirements: connectorInstanceId equals the protected environment value
operation is advertised by the installed capability profile
destructive operation is enabled by both the MC envelope and tenant environment

actions.name: For_each_change
actions.idempotency: Check durable tenant store before destructive or non-idempotent operations.

fieldPolicies.categories: Read current categories and @odata.etag, merge only the requested additions/removals, and PATCH with If-Match. On 412, re-read and retry the merge once before failing.
fieldPolicies.recurrence: Accept only a complete Graph patternedRecurrence object or null.
fieldPolicies.body: Reject stale writes when bodyLastModifiedDateTime no longer matches.
fieldPolicies.move: Create in destination, reconcile the new task ID, then delete source only after acknowledgement.
fieldPolicies.attachmentUpload: Disabled until a separate binary-safe tenant path is approved.

actions.name: Respond
requirements: Return one result for every input idempotency key
Echo connectorInstanceId and leaseId from the validated request
Use 200 for all success and 207 for mixed results
Never acknowledge failed or policy-skipped operations
